# Three.js 0.186.1

Unmodified local copies of `build/three.module.js`, `build/three.core.js`, and `LICENSE` (renamed `THREE-LICENSE.txt`) from the repository's installed, locked `three@0.186.1` dependency. Retain both adjacent modules and the MIT license. No CDN or runtime install is used. `SHA256SUMS` records their exact bytes.

To update, copy both build files and the license from the same reviewed dependency release, update the checksums, and repeat the model and browser validation. This game does not introduce a new npm dependency.
